dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Commanders (4-5-1) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Cardinals
bullets: Bengals Offensive Surge: Fresh off moving to 4-5-1 (3rd in NFC East) with a 22–20 win over Cincinnati, Washington piled up 428 total yards [Scott Jennings](https://www.hogshaven.com/pressers/456871/dan-quinn-brandon-aiyuk-hungry-play-ball-hes-hungry-be-here) [JP Finlay](https://x.com/JPFinlayNBCS/status/2125671464590315609). Jacory Croskey-Merritt totaled 77 scrimmage yards and 1 touchdown while Jayden Daniels threw for 289 yards and 0 TDs in Dan Quinn's attack [JP Finlay](https://x.com/JPFinlayNBCS/status/2125670727215194452).

Injury & Practice Status: Core starters enter Wednesday on track as medical staff monitor routine recovery ahead of the Arizona Cardinals [The Associated Press and Gina Cook](https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/sports/washington-commanders/commanders-wr-terry-mclaurin-out-for-the-season-after-knee-injury/4169719/).

Week 12 Cardinals Outlook: Dan Quinn and DC Daronte Jones open installation for the Arizona Cardinals (3-8, WSH -7, HC Mike LaFleur, OC Nathaniel Hackett & DC Nick Rallis (Road Test)) as Washington prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Ben Standig](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/2976212/stefon-diggs#:~:text=Diggs%20was%20absent%20from%20Wednesday's%20practice%20and).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 4-5-1 (3rd in NFC East • #11 Seed in NFC), Washington carries a 14.3% postseason projection, 13% NFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [bill-in-bangkok](https://www.hogshaven.com/washington-commanders-news/457532/commanders-rookie-drew-stevens-wins-nfc-special-teams-player-of-the-week).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Washington ranks #20 in Points / Game (21.8), #20 in Points Allowed / Game (24.3), #3 in Turnover Differential (+7), giving Dan Quinn and Daronte Jones a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 4:25 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Arizona Cardinals [bill-in-bangkok](https://www.hogshaven.com/washington-commanders-news/457323/for-the-first-time-in-years-its-fun-to-watch-the-commanders-play-defense).
